name: Ali Traders & Ali Polymers
tagline: Manufacturer & Distributor of Polymer Based Products
about: Ali Traders and Ali Polymers are an established manufacturing and wholesale distribution company with over 25 years of experience in polymer based products. Headquartered in Perumbavoor, Ernakulam, Kerala, India, we serve domestic and export markets with application focused, durable plastic solutions. We specialize in agriculture, construction, packaging, rain protection, and household plastic products, offering premium, standard, and economic grades manufactured from 100% virgin, semi-virgin, and reprocessed raw materials.
structure: Ali Traders and Ali Polymers operate as an integrated manufacturing, sourcing, and wholesale distribution organization. While Ali Polymers focuses on product development and sourcing, Ali Traders manages logistics and market reach across Kerala and expanding export destinations.
vision: To be a reliable global supplier of quality plastic products.
mission: To deliver durable, cost effective polymer solutions through ethical practices and consistent quality.
whyChooseUs: Wide product portfolio covering agriculture, construction, packaging, and household sectors
Multiple own brands catering to premium, standard, and economy segments
Flexible material options: 100% virgin, semi-virgin, and reprocessed grades
Consistent quality control and reliable supply chain
Export ready products with customized specifications

export.intro: Ali Traders & Ali Polymers provide export ready supply solutions for international buyers, distributors, and project contractors. Our products are manufactured to meet global quality expectations while offering competitive pricing and flexible specifications.
export.markets: Supporting domestic supply across India and expanding exports to the Middle East, Africa, and Asian markets with reliable shipping solutions.
support: Customized product specifications (GSM, size, color, packing)
moq: MOQ varies by product category and customization level
Standard export MOQ available for distributors and importers
packagingLogistics: Roll packing / bale packing / carton packing
